headline: Public hearings on zoning variances for projects at 366 Walnut Street, 114 Glen Bloom Drive, 18 Geneva Street, and other addresses.
summary: Nine zoning variance requests will get public hearings. Two rehearing requests on a May 14, 2026 decision for a 34-lot subdivision on Wellington Road are also on the agenda.
items: ZBA2026-052, 366 Walnut Street: 18’ x 20’ attached garage with a 2’ side yard setback where 5’ is required and a 1’ rear yard setback where 20’ is required
ZBA2026-053, 114 Glen Bloom Drive: 32’ x 40’ rear yard garage 23’ 8” tall where 20’ is allowed, and a new drive aisle with 29% front yard impervious area where 25% is allowed
ZBA2026-041, 18 Geneva Street: 28’ x 30’ single-family home with three stories where 2.5 are allowed and a height of 39’ where 35’ is allowed
ZBA2026-055, 218 South Lincoln Street: convert a two-family dwelling to a three-family dwelling in the R-2 district
ZBA2026-056, 82 Aladdin Street: 6’ x 20’ front porch with a roof and an 18.5’ front yard setback where 25’ is required
ZBA2025-057, 128 Hazelton Court: keep a 10’ x 12’ shed in the side yard about 6” from the side lot line where 10’ is required
ZBA2026-059, 4 Bremer Street: subdivide into Lots 13 and 13A, with a three-unit townhouse planned for Lot 13A, and several lot depth, setback, landscape, and transparency variances
ZBA2026-060, Wellington Road, Tax Map 860, Lot 30: subdivide into 34 lots, with six cul-de-sac lots having frontage of 70.59’ to 71.52’ where 100’ is required
ZBA2026-061, 550 River Road: keep a 26’ wide driveway where 24’ is allowed, with parking space and location variances
Rehearing request from John Bisson, Esq., on case ZBA2026-028, Wellington Road, Tax Map 860, Lot 30, granted May 14, 2026; request received June 11, 2026
Rehearing request from Jason Reimers (Agent) on case ZBA2026-028, Wellington Road, Tax Map 860, Lot 30, granted May 14, 2026; request received June 12, 2026
location: City Hall, Third Floor, Aldermanic Chambers, One City Hall Plaza

CITY OF MANCHESTER ZONING BOARD OF ADJUSTMENT PUBLIC HEARING AND 
LIMITED BUSINESS MEETING AGENDA 
Thursday, July 9, 2026, 6:00 PM 
City Hall, Third Floor, Aldermanic Chambers 
I. Call to Order 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order and introduce s the Zoning Board Members and City 
Staff. 
II. Public Hearing 
A. Current Cases 
1) ZBA2026-052, 366 Walnut Street 
MX-1 Zoning District, Ward 2 
Amanda and Elise Seibel propose to construct an 18’ x 20’ one-story, two-stall attached 
garage with a 2’ side yard setback where 5’ is required and a 1’ rear yard setback where 
20’ is required , in the MX-1 Zoning District, and seeks a variance from Section(s) 
5.3.1.A.3.E Minimum Setback of One Side and 5.3.1.A.3.F Minimum Rear Yard Setback 
of the Zoning Ordinance of the City of Manchester, New Hampshire as per documents 
submitted through May 29, 2026. 
2) ZBA2026-053, 114 Glen Bloom Drive 
R-1A Zoning District, Ward 8 
David Bryer propose to construct a 32’ x 40’ garage in the rear yard with a height of 23’ 
8” where 20’ is allowed and pave a new drive aisle, without widening the existing curb 
cut, resulting in impervious area in the front yard of 29% where 25% is allowed , in the 
R-1A Zoning District, and seek a variance from Section(s) 5.6.2.C Height of Accessory 
Structures in Rear Yard and 5.3.1.A.7.B Maximum Front Yard Impervious Area  of the 
Zoning Ordinance of the City of Manchester, New Hampshire as per documents 
submitted through May 29, 2026. 
3) ZBA2026-041, 18 Geneva Street 
R-1B Zoning District, Ward 10 
Norris Viviers proposes to construct a 28’ x 30’ single-family dwelling with three stories 
in height where 2.5 stories are allowed and with a height of 39’ where a height of 35’ is 
allowed, in the R-1B Zoning District, and seeks a variance from Section(s) 5.3.1.A.5.B 
Maximum Height in Stories and 5.3.1.A.5.C Maxim um Height in Feet  of the Zoning

through June 1, 2026.

R-2 Zoning District, Ward 9 
Andrew Sullivan , Esq.  (Agent) proposes to convert a two -family dwelling to a three -
family dwelling, in the R-2 Zoning District, and seeks a variance from Section(s) 4.3-A.1.C 
Multifamily Dwellin g of the Zoning Ordinance of the City of Manchester, New 
Hampshire as per documents submitted through June 11, 2026. 
5) ZBA2026-056, 82 Aladdin Street 
R-1A Zoning District, Ward 6 
Laura Melo (Agent) proposes to construct a 6’ x 20’ front porch with a roof with a front 
yard setback of 18.5’ where 25’ is required , in the R-1A Zoning District, and seeks a 
variance from Section(s) 5.3.1.A.3.C Minimum Front Yard Setbac k of the Zoning 
Ordinance of the City of Manchester, New Hampshire as per documents submitted 
through June 9, 2026. 
6) ZBA2025-057, 128 Hazelton Court 
R-1B Zoning District, Ward 12 
Keith and Lynn Lavallee  propose to  maintain a 10’ x 12’ shed in the side yard 
approximately 6” from the side lot line where 10’ is required, in the R-1B Zoning District, 
and seek a variance from Section(s) 5.6.2.B Accessory Structure Side Yard Setbac k of 
the Zoning Ordinance of the City of Manchester, New Hampshire as per documents 
submitted through June 10, 2026. 
7) ZBA2026-059, 4 Bremer Street 
MX-2 Zoning District, Ward 11 
Stephen Jenkins, Jr.  proposes to  subdivide the property where proposed Lot 13 will 
remain improved with a single-family dwelling, on a lot with lot depth ranging from 87.9’ 
to 37.3’ where 100’ is required, with an 11’ rear yard setback where 20’ is required, and 
where proposed Lot 13A wil l be developed with a three -unit townhouse, where the 
building’s primary façade does not face the primary frontage of Coolidge Ave., where 
the front yard setback from Coolidge Ave. is 58.7’ where a maximum front yard setback 
of 20’ is allowed, where the la ndscape buffer between individual driveways is 6’ wide 
where 8’ is required, and where the first floor primary façade has less than 15% 
transparency, in the R-1A Zoning District, and seeks a variance from Section(s) 
5.3.1.A.3.B Lot Depth and 5.3.1.A.3. F Minimum Rear Yard Setback for Lot 13 and 
5.3.1.E.3.C Maximum Front Yard Setback, 5.3.1.E.6.C Principal Entrance Location, 
8.1.4 Parking Drive Landscape and 5.3.1.E.6.A Minimum Transparency First Floor 
Primary Façade for Lot 13 A of the Zoning Ordinance of the City of Manchester, New 
Hampshire as per documents submitted through June 29, 2026.

8) ZBA2026-060, Wellington Road, Tax Map 860, Lot 30 
R-1A and LMPOD Zoning District, Ward 2 
Greg Balestriesi (Agent) proposes to subdivide the parcel into 34 lots, where six of the 
lots (TM 860, Lots 30J, 30K, 30L, 30P, 30Q and 30R) are located on cul-de-sacs and have 
lot frontage ranging from 70.59’ to 71.52’ where 100’ is required , in the R-1A Zoning

from Section(s) 5.3.1.A.3.A Minimum Lot Width (6 counts) of the Zoning Ordinance of 
the City of Manchester, New Hampshire as per documents submitted through June 16, 
2026. 
9) ZBA2026-061, 550 River Road 
R-1B Zoning District, Ward 1 
Melissa Dutile Cotter proposes to maintain a driveway expansion with a driveway width 
of 26’ where 24’ is allowed, with a parking space 0’ from the side lot line where 4’ is 
required, with three parking spaces within 10’ of the front lot line where two are 
allowed, and with one parking space partially between the building faç ade and the 
principle frontage , in the R-1B Zoning District, and seeks a variance from Section(s) 
7.4.2.A Maximum Driveway Width, 7.5.1.A Parking Setbacks From Lot Lines, 7.5.1.A.2 
Parking Spaces Within 10’ of the Front Lot Line, and 7.5.1.B.2 Principl e Frontage 
Parking of the Zoning Ordinance of the City of Manchester, New Hampshire as per 
documents submitted through June 16, 2026. 
III. Business Meeting 
A. Requests for Rehearing 
1) ZBA2026-028, Wellington Road, Tax Map 860, Lot 30 
R-1B Zoning District, Ward 1

GRANTED on May 14, 2026, an application to subdivide the parcel to create 34 new 
lots, where the proposed street accessing Wellington Rd. will be an impervious surface 
within 50’ of a wetland within the Lake Massabesic Protection Overlay District 
(LMPOD) in the R-1A Zoning District and Lake Massabesic Protection Overlay District 
(LMPOD), from the terms of Section(s) 6.3.7.C.2 Impervious Surface Within 50’ of 
Wetland in the LMPOD of the Zoning Ordinance of the City of Manchester, New 
Hampshire as per a request for rehearing received on June 11, 2026.
